name: Eilean Mor: The Lost Keepers
storyline:
In the early 1900s, all communication with the remote Eilean Mor lighthouse off the coast of Scotland was cut off. The light no longer shines at night. No one is answering the radio. And the three lighthouse keepers have vanished without a trace.

You are a reserve lighthouse keeper, sent to investigate the silence. What begins as a simple relief mission soon descends into a psychological horror experience one rooted in isolation, madness, and a mystery buried deep within the island.

Explore dark halls, uncover cryptic clues, and survive the haunting atmosphere of Eilean Mor in this story-rich, first-person horror adventure. As the fog thickens and reality begins to unravel, you must uncover the truth before you too disappear into the dark.
summary: In 1900, off the coast of Scotland, the Eilean Mor lighthouse has gone silent. The light is out, and its three keepers are missing. No one is answering the radio. As a reserve keeper, you’re sent to investigate this horror mystery. But beware you may become the fourth to vanish.
